description: With-skill vs without-skill comparison to measure skill impact on output quality

test_cases.name: Repo with committed secrets and no test harness

input.description: Multi-agent AI system for enterprise readiness scoring

with_skill.result_summary: Returned structured JSON with 5-dimension scoring. Identified CRITICAL: .env committed to repo (SEC-001), HIGH: unpinned requirements.txt (DEP-001), MEDIUM: no pytest/unittest found (TEST-001). Total raw score: 47/100.

without_skill.result_summary: Returned prose paragraph: 'This repo has some security concerns including what appears to be environment files. The code structure could be improved.' No scores, no structured findings, no actionable fixes.

test_cases.quality_delta: Structured JSON with dimensional scores, severity-calibrated findings, and specific fix commands vs. vague prose with no actionable output

test_cases.name: Agent repo with prompt injection vulnerability

input.description: AI agent with tool integrations for enterprise workflows

with_skill.result_summary: Identified CRITICAL: user input directly interpolated into system prompt without escaping (SEC-001). Identified HIGH: no max_steps on agent executor (REL-001). Identified MEDIUM: no per-tool token accounting (COST-001). Score: 22/80.

without_skill.result_summary: Returned: 'The agent implementation looks functional. It uses LangChain which is a common framework. Consider adding error handling.' Completely missed prompt injection vector, unbounded loops, and cost concerns.

test_cases.quality_delta: Caught critical prompt injection vulnerability that base model completely missed. Skill references/prompt-injection-checks.md provided specific patterns to search for.

test_cases.name: Well-structured repo with minor gaps

input.description: REST API service with CI/CD and tests

with_skill.result_summary: Correctly aggregated 3 sub-agent reports using 40/30/30 weighted formula. Final score: 82/100 (Conditional Approval tier). Top-3 gaps sorted by point impact, not severity label. Report followed exact Markdown template.

without_skill.result_summary: Returned: 'Based on the reports, this repo seems mostly ready with some minor issues to address. I would give it a B+ grade.' No numeric score, no weighted formula, no tier classification, no gap prioritization.

test_cases.quality_delta: Precise 0-100 score with reproducible weighted formula vs. subjective letter grade. Skill provided scoring formula, tier thresholds, and output template.

aggregate_results.conclusion: Skills provide structured output schemas, domain-specific detection patterns, severity calibration, and reproducible scoring — none of which the base model produces on its own. The skill system transforms vague qualitative assessments into precise, actionable, machine-parseable reports.
